name: Kurashiru,Inc.
summary: Kurashiru, Inc. has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, and plans, develops and manages mobile apps and web-based digital media. Its services include Kurashiru, a recipe video and shopping assistance platform, Kurashiru Job for recruitment, Kurashiru Rewards for saving money and Kurashiru Comparison for product evaluations. Dating from 2014 as dely inc., it is due to take its new name in October 2025.
